changelog:
protocol+ 
 Dashboard auto-recovery after network outage: waits for validated connection, retries once, never refreshes healthy pages. Local/offline content untouched. WebView Health Steward separated into Entity-stream scheduling, Chunked card rendering, Dormant quieting. Entity Filtering for low-memory devices with Passthrough card types.

Music Assistant WebSocket API integrated. Touch-friendly music rail beside detailed player, every layout supported. Browse, queue, transfer, sync groups, auto-stop timer, repeat/shuffle, autoplay, favorites. Local network discovery + manual address + mTLS. Sendspin audio path unchanged, works without MA sign-in. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback → Music Assistant sign-in.

Multi-room sync: This device / Other devices separation, sync delay adjustable, Auto calibrate at 0ms. Music transfer recognizes grouped devices, Clear peer on unsync removes stale queues.

#170 fixed: disabled controls no longer return on restart, no white flash at track change, queue no longer stops next song after 1s. Progress confirmed not guessed, calibration narrowed to genuine cases only.

Lyrics: MA synced lyrics prepared ahead, AMLL/LRCLIB/QQ Music fallback. Language rhythm improved, commas/pauses natural, short lines fixed. Single-line and three-line views independent, blank rows filtered, instrumental gaps as ♫♫.

Permission Manager: microphone, battery, camera, notifications, overlay, display, location, admin, accessibility in one place. Missing vs Not granted separated. Path: Settings → Device → Permission Manager.

Mod permissions separated by capability. Portal Mod works without Shizuku for basic sensors. Flashlight Mod becomes real HA switch with state feedback, fallback flash support. Update from Mod Store. Thanks @r.gil.

Screen Capture Mod: HA-triggered screenshots via Screen camera entity, LAN image address, Small/Medium/Original sizes. Accessibility or Shizuku/Root path. Returns to Permission Manager when missing. Install Screen Capture 1.0.5 from Mod Store.

HA misconfiguration guide: after 3 permanent failures, opens concise STT/TTS/Conversation agent guide. Detects fixed "could not understand" response. New installations keep stable HA identity, clearing data no longer creates new ESPHome device. Thanks @huaxinCLUB #165.

#157 checklist resolved: TTS no longer waits for caption paging, floating captions above screensaver, clearer speech after echo cancellation, reliable MA resume after voice. Echo cancellation rebuilt: Small room/Adaptive/Open plan labels, Standard/Light/Strong strength. Continuous conversation waits for long reply finish, transition prompt faded, single-turn clears color. microWakeWord fixes repeated confirmation path, offline verification once at 0.99 confidence. Thanks @ds2000 #166.

Polish: settings fade on entry, long descriptions scroll internally, system feedback consolidated, voice orb continuous between states, auto-dismiss on stuck Listening, dormant container rebuild, media controls off disables overlay, screensaver idle timer restarts on player collapse, update state retention improved.
